exposure: Obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASIS) in first vaginal delivery
cohort: 190 Women with a history of OASIS in their first vaginal delivery who had a subsequent vaginal birth
finding: The risk of repeat OASIS was 8.4% and associated with short second labor, epidural analgesia, and episiotomy in the first delivery.
mod_finding: The risk of repeat OASIS was associated with epidural analgesia (OR = 3.66; 95% CI: 1.14-11.71) and an episiotomy in the first delivery (OR = 3.93; 95% CI:1. 03-15.02).
